rules.title: 幾何拓撲防錯位規範 (Anti-Topology Swapping)
rules.rule: 若該頁原圖為「橫向 4 欄流程卡片」，提示詞必須強制約束『🚫 嚴禁退化為 2x2 矩陣』；若原圖為「2x2 四象限矩陣」，『🚫 嚴禁退化為水平時間軸』；若原圖為「連續 Chevron 流程箭頭」，『🚫 嚴禁退化為普通方塊』！每一頁的視覺拓撲必須剛性鎖定！

rules.title: 幾何組件實心飽滿填色 (Solid Color Fill, No Wireframes)
rules.rule: 所有箭頭、卡片與圖示徽章必須使用飽滿的實心色彩填充（Solid Color Fill），『🚫 絕對嚴禁生成黑色單線條無填色外框（Hollow Wireframe / Empty Outlines）』，確保畫面具備足夠的視覺量感與衝擊力！

rules.title: 步驟數量 1:1 剛性守恆 (Step-Count Integrity)
rules.rule: 原圖有幾個步驟（例如 4 步或 5 步），生成內容必須剛性產出相同數量的欄位或節點，『🚫 絕對嚴禁擅自合併或縮減步驟數量』！

rules.title: 圖表色彩純度防雜色污染 (Chart Palette Purity & Anti-Color Contamination)
rules.rule: 圓餅圖、長條圖與區域圖之數據組件，必須嚴格限定使用該風格指定之純色扁平填色；『🚫 嚴禁自動衍生非預期的泥褐色、濁黃色、中灰色等雜色扇形或長條』，維持色彩系統之純度！

rules.title: 插畫線條與形狀保真 (Vector Stroke & Graphic Fidelity)
rules.rule: 原圖若為向量線條插畫（如階梯、引線、軸線），必須維持簡潔之扁平向量線條；『🚫 嚴禁畸變為笨重之 3D 塊狀物或實心色塊堆疊』！

rules.title: Color Lock Constraint
rules.rule: Strictly limit palette to exact 3 colors: Crimson Red (#FF0033), Pure Black (#000000), and Off-White background (#F5F5F0). NO brown, NO yellow, NO grey, NO gradients. Force 100% flat vector flat colors.

rules.title: Visual Element Guardrail
rules.rule: Do NOT render 3D blocks or mud-colored shapes. If stairs/graphs are requested, render them using clean stroke lines or solid red/black flat vector shapes only.

rules.title: Chart Color Consistency
rules.rule: All pie slices and bar charts MUST strictly use solid Crimson Red or Pure Black. Prohibit automatically generating tertiary color fills (like beige, grey, brown) in chart elements.

rules.title: Layout Consistency
rules.rule: Maintain top-right red dot matrix grid (5x5) and exact vertical thick red accent border on the slide edges (left edge for slide 1, right edge for slide 3).

rules.title: 幾何架構鎖定
rules.rule: Strict Grid Enforcement: Maintain exact layout topology; do not replace a 2x3 grid with radial/arc timelines or vice versa.

rules.title: 渲染防空保底
rules.rule: Anti-Blank Canvas: Ensure all nodes, text fields, and visual anchors are fully populated; no empty slides or omitted containers.

rules.title: 色彩數量強約束
rules.rule: Color Cardinality: Exactly match the N-step dynamic color mapping per node; prohibit collapsing multi-color sequences into a single accent color.
